summary: Backend (18/18 pytest cases pass) and frontend (full mobile flow on web preview at 390x844) verified end-to-end for the 'His Word' app. Auth, verse matching with Claude Sonnet 4.5, daily verse, history, favorites, ElevenLabs TTS, and tab navigation all functional.

issues: Console deprecation warnings (non-blocking): 'shadow*' style props, TouchableWithoutFeedback (used in app/(tabs)/index.tsx), props.pointerEvents, expo-av (used in VersePlayer), expo-notifications push token listener on web. Replace before SDK 54 upgrade.

action_items: Optional: migrate VersePlayer from expo-av to expo-audio before SDK 54.
Optional: replace TouchableWithoutFeedback in app/(tabs)/index.tsx with Pressable.
Optional: migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow per RN web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (~407 lines) is single-file but well-structured; if it grows further consider splitting routers (auth, verses, tts, daily) into modules.
All MongoDB queries correctly project out _id.
JWT secret, ElevenLabs key, and Emergent LLM key are read from env (no hardcoding).
Email is normalised to lowercase on signup/login (good); tests need lowercase comparisons.
No rate-limiting / brute-force lockout on login (out of MVP scope but worth noting).
CORS allows '*' with allow_credentials=True - browsers will ignore credentialed responses with wildcard, but this app uses Bearer tokens so it is fine in practice.
Frontend api.ts uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly; no hardcoded URLs found.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (welcome, login, home, daily verse, verse match, favorite, saved tab, history tab, settings tab)

seed_data_creation: Seed user test@hisword.com / faith123 ensured by test_seed_user_login (creates if missing). Several TEST_<uuid>@hisword.com accounts created during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All endpoints (/api/auth/signup, /api/auth/login, /api/auth/me, /api/verses/match, /api/history, /api/favorites GET/POST/DELETE, /api/tts/generate, /api/daily-verse, /api/) confirmed working. ElevenLabs TTS returns valid MP3 (>1KB, ID3 header). Claude Sonnet 4.5 returns valid JSON for verse matching and daily verse. Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL and stores JWT in localStorage on web (storage.ts shim).
